name: MonarchPlanCard
title: PlanCard
summary: One plan in a plan picker: its name, price, who it is for, what it includes and a call to action, on a Monarch card.
whenToUse: In a plan picker or an upgrade screen, one card per plan.
whenNotToUse: For a single price in running text, write it as text. Do not use it to sell digital goods outside the store's billing: an in-app purchase must go through StoreKit, and the card only presents the plan.
api: MonarchPlanCard.init(_ name: String, price: String? = nil, period: String? = nil, priceNote: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, featuresLabel: String? = nil, features: [MonarchPlanCardFeature] = [], badge: String? = nil, footer: String? = nil, isHighlighted: Bool = false, isCurrent: Bool = false, currentPlanLabel: String? = nil, notIncludedLabel: String? = nil, @ViewBuilder action: () -> Action)

MonarchPlanCard.init(_ name: String, price: String? = nil, period: String? = nil, priceNote: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, featuresLabel: String? = nil, features: [MonarchPlanCardFeature] = [], badge: String? = nil, footer: String? = nil, isHighlighted: Bool = false, isCurrent: Bool = false, currentPlanLabel: String? = nil, notIncludedLabel: String? = nil) where Action == EmptyView
MonarchPlanCardFeature.init(_ label: String, hint: String? = nil, isIncluded: Bool = true)

options.name: name
options.description: The plan name, already localised. A heading.

options.name: price
options.description: The price as the product writes it, such as "$12" or "Contact us". Never formatted by the card.

options.name: period
options.description: Text after the price, such as "per seat / month".

options.name: priceNote
options.description: A line under the price, such as "Billed yearly".

options.name: description
options.description: One or two sentences on who the plan is for.

options.name: features
options.description: What the plan includes. A string literal is an included feature; isIncluded: false lists one it does not have.

options.name: badge
options.description: A short label beside the name, such as "Recommended".

options.name: isHighlighted
options.description: Emphasises the card as the recommended plan.

options.name: currentPlanLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in badge text "Current plan".

options.name: notIncludedLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken prefix "Not included:".

options.name: action
options.description: The call to action, normally one button.

states.name: default
states.description: A card with the subtle border and the smallest shadow.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: A 2-point accent border, a larger shadow and a solid badge.

states.name: current
states.description: An outline badge with "Current plan" beside the name.

appearance: The card surface with the subtle border in every theme. Included features have a checkmark in the success colour and default text; features that are not included have a dash and muted text. A highlighted card adds an accent border twice as wide as a normal border.
platformNotes: The web card takes any node for the name, price, features and footer and a heading level; here they are strings, the action is a view, and the name always has the header trait. The web badge on a highlighted card uses the accent tone; MonarchBadge has no accent tone, so it is a solid neutral badge. On the web the action follows the description and so it does here. An app that sells digital goods must use StoreKit for the purchase itself; the card does not start a purchase. Android uses the same name and parameters.
accessibility: The name has the header trait.
The price and its period are read as one element.
Each feature is one element. A feature that is not included is read with "Not included:" before it and shows a dash, so the difference does not depend on colour.
The action stays a separate element with its own touch target.
Highlighting is a wider border and a badge with text, not colour alone. The badge text is read with the header row.
All text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps; the name and badges, and the price and period, stack vertically when they do not fit on one line.
edgeCases: Only the name is required; every other part is left out when it is nil or empty.
A price without a period, and a period without a price, are both drawn.
A feature's hint is read after its label, separated by a comma.
The card fills the available width, like MonarchCard.

examples.title: Placeholder price and features
examples.code:
MonarchPlanCard(
    "Team",
    price: "₹X",
    period: "/ month",
    priceNote: "Billed monthly",
    description: "For teams that share work every day.",
    featuresLabel: "Everything in Starter, plus",
    features: [
        MonarchPlanCardFeature("Shared projects"),
        MonarchPlanCardFeature("Audit log", hint: "last 90 days"),
        MonarchPlanCardFeature("Single sign-on", isIncluded: false),
    ],
    badge: "Recommended",
    isHighlighted: true
) {
    MonarchButton(
        "Choose Team",
        variant: .primary,
        size: .md,
        fullWidth: true
    ) { choose() }
}

examples.title: The current plan, without an action
examples.code: MonarchPlanCard("Starter", price: "$0", period: "per month", isCurrent: true)
